english.title: Company officer fail to comply with requirement to provide customer info - Schedule 6 – Terrorism Act 2000
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the officer of an institution, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTITUTION..), which committed an offence under paragraph 1(3) of Schedule 6 to the Terrorism Act 2000 of failing to provide customer information for the purposes of a terrorist investigation, the offence having been committed with your consent or connivance or been attributable to your neglect
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 1(3) and 8(2) and 8(3) of Schedule 6 to the Terrorism Act 2000.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
